findings.issue: נִבְלָתָם is one carcass with a 3mp suffix (their). “su” after singular “alzante” reads as the lifter’s own carcass, shifting the possessor from 3mp to 3ms.
הָעָרֶב is the evening. “la tarde” also covers the afternoon, so the time span can be earlier and wider than the token.

notes: lavará, sus vestidos, and ustedes match the 3ms washer and 2mp לָכֶם; the verbless clause adds no unmarked copula.
